 PATEL BHIKHIBEN CHATURBHAI  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR HARNISH V DARJI(3705) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1,2 for the Respondent(s) No. 2,3 MR. SANJAY UDHWANI, ASSISTANT GOVERNMENT PLEADER/PP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI) 1

By way of present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, following prayers have been made:
"(a) To admit this Special Civil Application.
(b) To allow this Special Civil Application by issuing appropriate writ, order or direcdtion directing the Respondent authorities to send the reference application of the petitioner dated 14/11/2006 (Annexure-B) of the petitioner under the provisions of the Sec.18 of the Land Acquisition Act to the District Court or its determination in accordance with law, in the interest of justice.

entities.text: Patel Bhikhiben Chaturbhai vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (e) To award the cost of the petition from the respondent authority.

(f) Grant such other and further relief as deem fit and just in the facts and circumstances of the case."
2

Though the petition is filed after a long delay of 17 years from the date of filing of application, but considering the fact about paying just and proper compensation for the land acquired, we dispose of this petition with the following direction:
The respondents are hereby directed to look into the matter and shall pass appropriate orders in accordance with law at the earliest, preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of this order.
However, it is made clear that we have not gone into C/SCA/6475/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/04/2023 merits of the matter.
3 The petition is disposed of, accordingly.

However, it is made clear that we have not gone into C/SCA/6475/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/04/2023 merits of the matter.
3 The petition is disposed of, accordingly.
